# Lakeview Hilltop Homestay

> Lakeview Hilltop Homestay is a luxury hilltop resort and homestay located in Deolo, Kalimpong, West Bengal, India, offering panoramic Kanchenjunga sunrise views, authentic Himalayan hospitality, cozy wooden cottage suites, and starlit bonfire and barbecue evenings.

## Overview
- **Property Name**: Lakeview Hilltop Homestay
- **Website**: https://lakeviewhilltophomestay.com/
- **Location**: Deolo, Kalimpong, West Bengal 734301, India
- **Elevation**: Approx. 5,500+ ft on Deolo Hill
- **Viewpoint**: Unobstructed panorama of Mount Kanchenjunga and Kalimpong valleys
- **Hosts**: Anirban (+91 9123944062) and Bachhu Roy (+91 9830250611)
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/lakeviewhilltophomestay/

## Key Amenities & Facilities
- **Free Wi-Fi & Power Backup**: High-speed internet across all rooms and common viewing decks.
- **24/7 Hot & Cold Water**: Instant geyser setups in all private attached bathrooms.
- **Free Private Parking**: Secure on-premise parking for private cars, SUVs, and tourist vehicles.
- **Pick and Drop Facility Available**: Smooth station/airport transfers from New Jalpaiguri (NJP) Railway Station and Bagdogra (IXB) Airport.
- **Local Sightseeing Facility Available**: Customized itineraries covering Deolo Park, Science City, Delo Paragliding, Dr. Graham's Homes, and Lava-Rishyap.
- **Bonfire & BBQ Setups Under the Stars**: Outdoor stone firepit with charcoal barbecue skewers (available at a nominal extra charge).
- **Flat-Screen Satellite TV**: In-room HD television entertainment.
- **24/7 CCTV Security**: Comprehensive round-the-clock surveillance for guest peace of mind.

## Accommodations & Rooms
1. **Deluxe Wooden Mountain View Room**: Queen double bed, warm floral duvets, pine interiors, attached geyser bath, valley view window.
2. **Family Quad Suite**: Spacious quadruple bed setup designed for families and small travel groups.
3. **Pine Paneled Mountain Suite**: Luxury wood-paneled cottage suite framing snow peaks.
